lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zr6Ga6Al6 (reduced formula ZrGaAl) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all three elements adopt a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement with eight geometric neighbors per center atom: Ga and Al are each surrounded by 8 Zr, while Zr is coordinated by 4 Al and 4 Ga, all at 2.9338 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 18 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates corner- and face-sharing between Al and Ga 8-vertex coordination polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between like Al–Al and Ga–Ga polyhedra.
